text:
Alex Rivera: Hey @security @eng — customer (EU bank) asked for a dataflow diagram + explicit subprocessor ownership mapping for the POC. They need hosting boundaries, KMS location, log retention, and an on‑prem/VPC option. Deadline EOD Fri. Who can own?
Maria Chen: Adding context — audit team wants a CSV of subprocessors + contact, and a signed subproc addendum if we use third parties. They also asked if logs can be pushed to their SIEM.
Jamal Ortiz: We can produce a redacted dataflow SVG and a subprocessors CSV. KMS: customer‑managed keys supported for Dedicated & Private (KMS in‑region). Hosted uses cloud provider keys; we can provide attestation and SOC docs. @Elena can confirm log routing options.
Elena Park: Logs: for Private we can forward via VPC peering -> customer S3/CloudWatch/Splunk. For Dedicated we can enable forwarding to customer SIEM with an outbound connector. Hosted has limited push capabilities (partner connector). Need a support ticket to enable. Example config snippet: ```
vpc_peering: true
kms_region: eu-west-1
log_sink: s3://customer-bucket/poc-logs
```
security-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.internal/secure/presales/checklists/182 — attach SIG/CAIQ extracts, subprocessors.csv, dataflow.svg.
Alex Rivera: Do we have a canonical list of subprocessors for eu hosting (infra, monitoring, analytics, logs) I can attach to the presales packet?
Maria Chen: Quick list off the top: AWS (eu-west-1) for infra, Datadog for metrics, Sentry for errors, an analytics vendor on some plans. I'll pull legal names and contract owners — Jamal can confirm tech details.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll export the current subproc registry and create a minimal dataflow diagram by EOD. For the on‑prem option I'll include network ACLs and required peering steps. Note: PII can be configured to not leave customer VPC on Private/Dedicated.
Elena Park: :thumbsup: Opening INF-1234 to produce artifacts (dataflow.svg, dataflow.png, subprocessors.csv, retention matrix). Any requested formats?
Alex Rivera: SVG + PNG for diagrams, CSV for subprocessors with columns: provider | country | role | contract_owner | contact_email. Legal prefers that layout.
Maria Chen: I'll loop in Legal for the addendum template and signoff language. @Jamal @Elena please cc me on deliverables.
Jamal Ortiz: Pinged legal and started the export. Retention defaults: logs 30d (hosted), configurable to customer SLA for Dedicated/Private. Will include a short note on fallback behavior (model variant routing) for the POC.
Maria Chen: One more ask from the customer — can we include a short section on data residency enforcement controls (KMS, network isolation, audit logs)?
Jamal Ortiz: Yep — will include controls list: KMS region binding, VPC isolation, token redaction, access logs, and audit export.
Alex Rivera: Great, thanks everyone. I’ll aggregate and send to the customer once INF-1234 artifacts are uploaded.
Maria Chen: Thanks — will follow up with Legal for addendum.
Elena Park: Done, INF-1234 created.
security-bot: Reminder: attach SIG/CAIQ snippets and the subprocessors CSV to the presales package before handoff.
Alex Rivera: Ack.
